name: application-kanban-column
title: Kanban Column
description: Draggable card column for kanban boards, with a status header, count badge, tag/assignee-labeled cards, and an add-card affordance.
useWhen: Building a kanban or task board where work items move between status columns.
You need a compact card format showing a title, tag, and assignee without opening a detail view.
The column count of items needs to be visible at a glance alongside the status label.
avoidWhen: The data is naturally tabular and benefits from sortable columns — use a data table instead.
There is no drag/reorder or status-grouping concept — a plain list or stat grid is simpler.
You need full board orchestration (persisted column state, cross-column drop handling) — this component is the column primitive; compose your own board state around it.
responsiveBehavior: The column has a fixed 18rem (w-72) width designed to sit in a horizontally scrolling board row; stack columns vertically on narrow viewports if used standalone.
accessibility: Cards are native draggable list items; keyboard-only reordering is not implemented and should be added via your own drag-and-drop library if required.
The count badge is supplementary to the visible column title, not a replacement for it.
Assignee initials rely on a tooltip or accessible name from your own avatar/user data in production use.

variants.title: Kanban Column
variants.description: Status header with colored dot and count badge, draggable cards with tag and assignee avatar, and an add-card button.
accessibility: Card tags use both color and text label so status is not conveyed by color alone.

variants.title: Kanban Column (Dark)
variants.description: Draggable kanban column adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Card and tag colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
